name: Quality
title: More than meets the eye.
description: The grain of wood, the finish of a joint and the texture of fabric give a design its character. Looking at these details up close is part of getting to know your furniture.

section-1.title: Get to know the material.
section-1.body: The grain of wood, the finish of a joint and the texture of fabric give a design its character. Looking at these details up close is part of getting to know your furniture.

section-2.title: Each design has its own construction.
section-2.body: Frames, fillings and surface materials vary between products. Explore the specifications of your chosen model with our team to find what suits your home.

section-3.title: Care is part of everyday life.
section-3.body: The right care depends on the finish and fabric you choose. Ask for model-specific guidance before cleaning; our store team can help.
